verses.t: This is the beginning of the ancient stories here in the Quiché.

Here we shall write and begin the ancient stories, the beginning and origin of all that was done in the town of the Quiché, the town of the Quiché Indians; and from here we shall take up how it was declared and made manifest and told, the hiding and the revealing, by the Former and Creator, the Mother and Father, as they are called: Hun-ahpu-vuch, Hun-ahpu-uhú, Zaquinimatzyz, Tepeu, Cucumatz, Vguxcho, Vguxpalo (names or titles which mean: a hunter opossum, a hunter coyote, white coati, Lord, strong serpent, heart of the lake, heart of the sea, he of the green bowl, he of the green gourd). And together with them is told and spoken of that grandmother and grandfather called Xpiyacoc and Xmucane, proper names of protectors and shelterers, twice grandmother and twice grandfather, as they are called in the Quiché stories, who shared in all that was done afterwards in the state of light and in the word of light. This we shall now write under the law of God, in Christendom; we shall bring it out, because there is no longer the common book, the original, in which to see it. It came from the other side of the sea, where it was seen, which is called the teaching of our darkness by the sight of clear life. In ancient times there was an original book, written long ago, but it is hidden from whoever looks and whoever thinks. Great is its coming and its account of how all the sky and the earth were finished and formed: how they were squared and divided into four parts, how they were marked out and staked with stakes, measured with lines or cords, and how the cord was stretched across the sky and across the earth, which are said to have four corners and four sides, by the Former and Creator, the mother and father of life and of creation, who gives breath and being, the begetter and keeper of peace, the light of the children, the thinker and knower of all the beauty there is in the sky, the earth, the lakes and the sea.
